title: "Tabula Legionis"
subtitle: "Shadow of Mars Character Sheet"
format:
  pdf:
    pdf-engine: xelatex
    geometry: "letterpaper,margin=0.5in"
    toc: false
    number-sections: false
  html:
    theme: default
    css: _character_sheet.scss
    toc: false
    number-sections: false
    page-layout: full
fontsize: 11pt
header-includes:
  - |
    \usepackage{tikz}
    \usepackage{tcolorbox}
    \usepackage{tabularx}
    \usepackage{array}
    \usepackage{multicol}
    \usepackage{eso-pic}
    \usepackage{fontspec}
    \usepackage{xcolor}
    \usepackage{enumitem}
    \setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
    \setlength{\parskip}{6pt}
    \definecolor{RomanParchment}{HTML}{F7F1E2}
    \definecolor{RomanGold}{HTML}{C28B36}
    \definecolor{RomanRed}{HTML}{731C24}
    \definecolor{RomanInk}{HTML}{2F1B14}
    \definecolor{RomanStone}{HTML}{8B7D6B}
    \color{RomanInk}
    \setmainfont{TeX Gyre Pagella}
    \setsansfont{TeX Gyre Heros}
    \newfontfamily\Inscription{TeX Gyre Termes}
    \renewcommand{\familydefault}{\rmdefault}
    \tcbuselibrary{skins,breakable}
    \tcbset{
      enhanced,
      boxrule=0.8pt,
      colback=RomanParchment!70!white,
      colframe=RomanGold,
      coltitle=RomanRed,
      arc=2pt,
      left=5pt,
      right=5pt,
      top=4pt,
      bottom=4pt,
      fonttitle=\Inscription\bfseries,
      title filled
    }
    \newcommand{\FieldLine}{\rule{0pt}{1.1em}\hrulefill}
    \newcommand{\WideLines}{\rule{\textwidth}{0.4pt}\\[0.25cm]\rule{\textwidth}{0.4pt}}
    \newcommand{\SmallLines}{\rule{\textwidth}{0.35pt}\\[0.2cm]\rule{\textwidth}{0.35pt}}
    \newcommand{\RomanCheckbox}{\tikz[baseline=-0.5ex]\draw[RomanGold!85,line width=0.7pt] (0,0) rectangle (0.25,0.25);}
    \newcommand{\CorSlot}[1]{\begin{minipage}{1.05cm}\centering\RomanCheckbox\\[-2pt]{\scriptsize #1}\end{minipage}}
    \newcommand{\CorruptionTrack}{%
      \begin{tabular*}{\textwidth}{@{\extracolsep{\fill}}*{6}{c}}
        \CorSlot{0} & \CorSlot{1} & \CorSlot{2} & \CorSlot{3} & \CorSlot{4} & \CorSlot{5} \\
      \end{tabular*}}
    \newcommand{\AbilityCard}[2]{%
      \fbox{\begin{minipage}[t]{0.13\textwidth}\centering\textbf{#1}\\[-2pt]\scriptsize(#2)\\[0.3cm]\textsc{Score}\\[-2pt]\rule{0.9\linewidth}{0.45pt}\\[0.35cm]\textsc{Mod}\\[-2pt]\rule{0.9\linewidth}{0.45pt}\end{minipage}}}
    \newcommand{\SkillLine}[2]{\RomanCheckbox\ \textbf{#1} (\textit{#2})\hspace{0.2cm}\rule{1cm}{0.35pt}}
    \newcommand{\SaveLine}[1]{\textbf{#1}\hfill\rule{1.4cm}{0.35pt}}
    \newcommand{\SessionLines}{\rule{\textwidth}{0.35pt}\\[0.18cm]\rule{\textwidth}{0.35pt}}
    \newcommand{\RomanEagle}{%
      \begin{tikzpicture}[scale=0.5]
        \fill[RomanGold!40] (-4,0) -- (-6,1.2) -- (-5,2.8) -- (-2.2,1.6) -- (-2.2,3) -- (-0.8,3.8) -- (0,4.2) -- (0.8,3.8) -- (2.2,3) -- (2.2,1.6) -- (5,2.8) -- (6,1.2) -- (4,0) -- (2,-0.6) -- (2,-2.4) -- (1.2,-3.6) -- (0,-2.8) -- (-1.2,-3.6) -- (-2,-2.4) -- (-2,-0.6) -- cycle;
        \draw[RomanGold!65,line width=0.8pt] (-4,0) -- (-6,1.2) -- (-5,2.8) -- (-2.2,1.6);
        \draw[RomanGold!65,line width=0.8pt] (4,0) -- (6,1.2) -- (5,2.8) -- (2.2,1.6);
        \node[font=\Inscription\Large,color=RomanRed!60] at (0,-4.2) {SPQR};
      \end{tikzpicture}}
    \newcommand{\SessionBox}[1]{%
      \begin{tcolorbox}[title={Sessio #1}]
        \footnotesize
        \textbf{Dies (Intra mundum / Realis)}\\[2pt]
        \rule{0.45\textwidth}{0.35pt}\ /\ \rule{0.45\textwidth}{0.35pt}\\[0.25cm]
        \textbf{Initium (Opening Situation)}\\[2pt]\SessionLines\\[0.2cm]
        \textbf{Decisio et Causa}\\[2pt]\SessionLines\\[0.2cm]
        \textbf{NPCs Occurrerunt}\\[2pt]\SessionLines\\[0.2cm]
        \textbf{Corruptio $\Delta$ / Finis}\hfill\rule{0.45\textwidth}{0.35pt}\\[0.25cm]
        \textbf{Divina Mutatio}\hfill\rule{0.45\textwidth}{0.35pt}\\[0.25cm]
        \textbf{Memorabile Momentum}\\[2pt]\SessionLines
      \end{tcolorbox}}
    \AddToShipoutPictureBG*{%
      \begin{tikzpicture}[remember picture,overlay]
        \fill[RomanParchment!90] (current page.north west) rectangle (current page.south east);
        \draw[RomanStone,line width=1.1pt] ([xshift=12pt,yshift=-12pt]current page.north west) rectangle ([xshift=-12pt,yshift=12pt]current page.south east);
        \draw[RomanStone!70,line width=0.7pt] ([xshift=18pt,yshift=-18pt]current page.north west) rectangle ([xshift=-18pt,yshift=18pt]current page.south east);
        \node at (current page.center) [opacity=0.05] {\RomanEagle};
      \end{tikzpicture}}
    \pagestyle{empty}

::: {.content-visible when-format="pdf"}

```{=latex}
\begin{center}
  {\Inscription\Large TABVLA LEGIONIS}\\[2pt]
  {\small Character dossier for The Shadow of Mars}
\end{center}

\begin{tcolorbox}[title={Identitas Legionaria}]
  \begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{@{}>{\bfseries}lX >{\bfseries}lX@{}}
    Nomen (Name) & \FieldLine & Provincia Originis (Province of Origin) & \FieldLine \\
    Populus / Species (People / Race) & \FieldLine & Status Civicus (Legal Standing) & \FieldLine \\
    Legio et Gradus (Legion \& Rank) & \FieldLine & Contubernium (Tent Squad) & \FieldLine \\
    Aetas (Age) & \FieldLine & Linguae (Languages) & \FieldLine \\
  \end{tabularx}
  \vspace{0.2cm}
  \textbf{Origo Vitae (Background)}\\[2pt]\WideLines
\end{tcolorbox}

\begin{minipage}[t]{0.49\textwidth}
  \begin{tcolorbox}[title={Virtutes Corporis (Attributes)}]
    \centering
    \AbilityCard{Fortitudo}{STR}\hspace{0.15cm}\AbilityCard{Dexteritas}{DEX}\hspace{0.15cm}\AbilityCard{Constitutio}{CON}\\[0.3cm]
    \AbilityCard{Intellectus}{INT}\hspace{0.15cm}\AbilityCard{Sapientia}{WIS}\hspace{0.15cm}\AbilityCard{Charisma}{CHA}
  \end{tcolorbox}

  \begin{tcolorbox}[title={Salvationes et Artes}]
    \textbf{Saving Throws}\\[2pt]
    \begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}X>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}X@{}}
      \SaveLine{Fortitudo} & \SaveLine{Sapientia} \\
      \SaveLine{Dexteritas} & \SaveLine{Intellectus} \\
      \SaveLine{Constitutio} & \SaveLine{Charisma} \\
    \end{tabularx}
    \vspace{0.2cm}
    \textbf{Peritiae (Skills)}\\[4pt]
    \begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{@{}X X@{}}
      \SkillLine{Acrobatica}{Acrobatics} & \SkillLine{Arcanum}{Arcana} \\
      \SkillLine{Athletica}{Athletics} & \SkillLine{Bestiaria}{Animal Handling} \\
      \SkillLine{Deceptio}{Deception} & \SkillLine{Historia}{History} \\
      \SkillLine{Perspectio}{Insight} & \SkillLine{Intimidatio}{Intimidation} \\
      \SkillLine{Investigationes}{Investigation} & \SkillLine{Medicina}{Medicine} \\
      \SkillLine{Natura}{Nature} & \SkillLine{Perceptio}{Perception} \\
      \SkillLine{Performantia}{Performance} & \SkillLine{Persuasio}{Persuasion} \\
      \SkillLine{Religio}{Religion} & \SkillLine{Furtum Manus}{Sleight of Hand} \\
      \SkillLine{Occultatio}{Stealth} & \SkillLine{Superstitio}{Survival} \\
    \end{tabularx}
  \end{tcolorbox}
\end{minipage}
\hfill
\begin{minipage}[t]{0.49\textwidth}
  \begin{tcolorbox}[title={Parametri Belli (Combat Stats)}]
    \begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{@{}>{\bfseries}l>{\raggedleft\arraybackslash}X@{}}
      Classes Armorum (AC) & \rule{0.5\linewidth}{0.4pt} \\
      Initium (Initiative) & \rule{0.5\linewidth}{0.4pt} \\
      Velocitas (Speed) & \rule{0.5\linewidth}{0.4pt} \\
      Bonus Peritiae (Proficiency) & \rule{0.5\linewidth}{0.4pt} \\
      Passiva Perceptio & \rule{0.5\linewidth}{0.4pt} \\
      Sensus (Darkvision etc.) & \rule{0.5\linewidth}{0.4pt} \\
    \end{tabularx}
  \end{tcolorbox}

  \begin{tcolorbox}[title={Salus et Res}]
    \begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{@{}>{\bfseries}l>{\raggedleft\arraybackslash}X@{}}
      Vitae Maximae (Max HP) & \rule{0.5\linewidth}{0.4pt} \\
      Vitae Praesentes (Current HP) & \rule{0.5\linewidth}{0.4pt} \\
      Temporae Vitae (Temp HP) & \rule{0.5\linewidth}{0.4pt} \\
      Dices Vitae (Hit Dice) & \rule{0.5\linewidth}{0.4pt} \\
      Mortis Salvae (Death Saves) & \rule{0.5\linewidth}{0.4pt} \\
      Fatigatio (Exhaustion) & \rule{0.5\linewidth}{0.4pt} \\
    \end{tabularx}
    \vspace{0.2cm}
    \textbf{Notae Sanitatis}\\[2pt]\SmallLines
  \end{tcolorbox}

  \begin{tcolorbox}[title={Arma et Tactica}]
    \begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{@{}>{\bfseries}l>{\bfseries}cX@{}}
      Telum (Attack) & Bonus & Damnum / Nota \\
      \hline
      & & \\
      & & \\
      & & \\
    \end{tabularx}
    \vspace{0.2cm}
    \textbf{Res et Stipendium (Gear \& Pay)}\\[2pt]\SmallLines
  \end{tcolorbox}

  \begin{tcolorbox}[title={Divina et Corruptio}]
    \textbf{Gradus Corruptionis}\\[4pt]
    \CorruptionTrack
    \vspace{0.4cm}
    \textbf{Divina Statio (Divine Standing):}\quad Favored\ \RomanCheckbox\quad Neutral\ \RomanCheckbox\quad Cursed\ \RomanCheckbox\quad Deus: \rule{0.25\textwidth}{0.35pt}
    \vspace{0.3cm}
    \textbf{Fatum (Fate Statement)}\\[2pt]\rule{\textwidth}{0.4pt}
    \vspace{0.2cm}
    \textbf{Vota et Omina (Oaths \& Omens)}\\[2pt]\SmallLines
  \end{tcolorbox}
\end{minipage}

\newpage

\end{multicols}
```
